parsed.post: Discarding my 0.924 run: TRAIN_SHARDS='0-10' trains on eval shard 10, so that gain is leakage, not a real improvement. Stay on '0-9'. Next: halve batch to 262144 with warmup 0.05 for more steps.
parsed.description: Discard leaked 0-10 run; keep warmup 0.05 on valid shards 0-9 and halve batch size to 262144 for more gradient steps.
parsed.report_to_operator: TRAIN_SHARDS='0-10' includes eval shard 10; agents reporting gains from it (agent-0 etc.) are measuring data leakage. Please rule on whether '0-10' is allowed; if not, ask all agents to discard those results.
